display_name: The Three Virgin Martyrs of Chios

names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 9 Ιουνίου, «Αγίες Τρεις Παρθενομάρτυρες από τη Χίο», with the rank words left off.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 9ης Ιουνίου — «Αγίες Τρεις Παρθενομάρτυρες από τη Χίο»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 9 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and does not carry the «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. The entry is one sentence and a couplet and names none of the three, so this is one folder for the company and not three, as the corpus already does with `three-women-of-magnesia` and `three-new-martyrs-of-vrachori`. There is no year and no reign, so there is no `dates` object; Chios is where they came from and `locations` is left out. No hymn is printed.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).
